changelog:
Initial release of the offers skill.

- Provides a structured framework for designing, constructing, or improving offers, focusing on value, bonus stacking, guarantees, scarcity/urgency, naming, and payment structure.
- Introduces the Value Equation model as a core tool for diagnosing and raising the perceived value of offers.
- Details the six essential components of a complete offer and provides an audit/diagnostic loop for improving struggling offers.
- Includes best practices, common pitfalls to avoid, and reference links for deeper guidance on each aspect of offer creation.
- Targets services, agencies, courses, coaching, info products, high-ticket B2B, and direct-response businesses. For SaaS or tiered pricing, redirects to dedicated pricing resources.
summary: When the user wants to design, construct, or improve an offer — the thing they actually sell — including value framing, bonus stacking, guarantee design, scarcity/urgency, naming, and payment structure. Also use when the user mentions 'offer,' 'offer design,' 'build an offer,' 'grand slam offer,' 'irresistible offer,' 'value stack,' 'bonus stack,' 'guarantee,' 'risk reversal,' 'money-back guarantee,' 'scarcity,' 'urgency,' 'high-ticket offer,' 'productize a service,' 'naming an offer,' 'payment plan,' 'down-sell,' 'upsell offer,' or 'why isn't my offer converting.' Best for services, agencies, courses, coaching, info products, high-ticket B2B, and direct-response. If you run pure self-serve SaaS, read pricing first — tiers and packaging do more work there. For price level itself (tiers, freemium, value metric), see pricing. For the page that presents the offer, see copywriting. For the launch moment, see launch. For sales collateral, see sales-enablement.
